[EN] Of course this region's dangerous. It's not called the wilds for nothing.

That doesn't mean we shouldn't go, simply that we should be prudent in our explorations. Going alone is folly and that poor scholar who they found pieces of died pointlessly.
[ES] Por supuesto que esta región es peligrosa. No la llaman la naturaleza salvaje por nada.

Eso no significa que no debamos ir, simplemente que debemos ser prudentes en nuestras exploraciones. Ir solo es una locura y ese pobre erudito del que encontraron pedazos murió en vano.
